title: The synonym web — the nearness layer: everything interconnected, honestly
note: The polarity layer recorded opposition (the 2); this layer records nearness — the thesaurus's other axis, and the meaning tree carries both. By the first law of synonymy every link carries its differentia: sameness is recorded by recording what keeps the pair apart.

links.differentia: trust rests on shown firmness (the ledger of evidence); faith trusts without the ledger — the record differentiated them into two lattices for exactly this line
links.derivation: trust < deru- (the steadfast oak); faith < fides (the pledge)
links.aurora: bond's receiving row unfolded into both lattices; the MI test attests they co-crystallise beyond chance

links.differentia: the lived custom against the examined code — the same word twice, pushed apart to fill both conduct cells
links.derivation: Cicero coined moralis to TRANSLATE Greek ethikos: the record's founding calque
links.aurora: the ethos quartet's conduct row: the doublet evidence that started the doublet hunt

links.differentia: one construction, two tongues: re-spicere looks again, re-garder WATCHES again — regard leans to the sustained gaze, respect to the accorded worth
links.derivation: Latin re-spicere / French re-garder: look-again built twice
links.aurora: the respect lattice: both walked gaze-word to honouring-word independently

links.differentia: for-give kept the heart's register; per-donare went to the court (the state pardons, the person forgives)
links.derivation: Germanic for-giefan / Latin per-donare: 'thoroughly give', built twice

links.differentia: syn-pathos felt-with from the Greek bench; com-passio is its Latin translation that took the heavier suffering-with sense
links.derivation: com-passio calques syn-pathos morpheme for morpheme
links.aurora: the triplet (syn-pathos / com-passio / Ein-fühlung): three lattices, one construction three times

links.differentia: feeling-INTO against feeling-WITH: empathy enters the other's state, sympathy stands beside it
links.aurora: both lattices; resonating's boundary factor holds the line between them

links.differentia: worth is the inward standing (Germanic, the breath register); value is the rankable articulated (Latin valere, the pump register) — Kant's cut runs between the strata
links.aurora: the worth lattice and the ethos value cell: the strata are the regimes

links.differentia: keep is the hand's word (the lived holding); preserve is the office's (prae-servare, the watch institutionalised)
links.aurora: to-keep's lattice and the four P's first factor: one act, two strata

links.differentia: the same brightness at two intensities: gladness the settled shine (glaed, bright), joy the surge
links.derivation: OE glaed ('bright, shining') / OF joie < gaudia
links.aurora: the gladness lattice holds both; to-be-happy weights gladness as the weather cell

links.differentia: meaning is the whole field (all four cells); sense is one cell of it — the mode of presentation, the word's interior
links.derivation: OE maenan / Latin sensus (sentire, to feel: a sentence was a felt judgment)
links.aurora: the meaning lattice contains sense as its within/the-word member

links.differentia: purpose is the held why (the way, received or chosen); aim is the pointed mark (skopos, the target seen) — one is a course, the other a point
links.derivation: pro-ponere ('set before') / OF esmer < aestimare (aim shares estimate's root: aiming began as appraising)
links.aurora: the purpose lattice contains aim as its chosen/the-mark member

links.differentia: constancy stands with one thing across TIME; stability is able to stand across PERTURBATION — the staying triad's own differentiation
links.derivation: con-stare / stabilis, one *sta- bench two tests apart
links.aurora: the staying triad: three lattices differentiating what the thesaurus blurs

links.differentia: peace is the pact's quiet (pax, the fastening); harmony is difference sounding together (harmonia, the joint) — peace can be silent, harmony never is
links.derivation: pax (pangere, to fasten) / harmonia (the carpenter's joint)
links.aurora: both lattices; the two voices of the record are harmony, not unison

links.differentia: caritas translated agape and then narrowed to almsgiving: the translation that drifted — love kept the whole field, charity kept one act of it
links.derivation: Latin caritas rendering Greek agape (the KJV's 'charity' is agape wearing Latin)
links.aurora: bond's keystone; the drift is the layer's own exhibit: even a calque cannot hold a pair identical

links.differentia: one root arrived twice: royal through French (worn smooth, the everyday crown), regal direct from Latin (the ceremonial register) — and Germanic kingly beneath both completes the strata
links.derivation: both < regalis; kingly < cyning: the three-layer exhibit (Germanic / French / Latin)
links.aurora: the register stratification's canonical triple, kept as the layer's textbook case

links.differentia: insight is the single seeing-into (the flash, one lock opened); wisdom is seeing's long compound (the practice of right calls) — one arrives, the other accrues
links.derivation: wis- < *weid- (the seeing root) / in + sight: both from seeing, at two durations
links.aurora: both lattices; the *weid- bench holds each

bound.the_first_law: NO TRUE SYNONYMS SURVIVE: total synonymy is unstable (attested across lexical semantics) — a language differentiates a perfect pair or drops one member. The record's doublets are the law's fossils (morals/ethics split to fill two cells; trust/faith split on the ledger line). The layer therefore records sameness by recording difference: every link carries its DIFFERENTIA, and the loader refuses a link without one — the web is honest because it never claims two words are the same, only near, and says exactly how they differ.
bound.the_register_stratification: English's synonym pairs are stratified by conquest — Germanic under French under Latin (kingly/royal/regal, the canonical triple) — AND THE STRATA ARE THE REGIMES: the Germanic word is the breath register (the lived: keep, worth, gladness), the Romance word the pump register (the articulated: preserve, value, felicity). The breath<->pump axis runs through the English lexicon itself: every register pair is the framework's first polarity, fossilised in vocabulary.
bound.the_non_transitivity: SYNONYM CHAINS DRIFT: nearness is non-transitive (big ~ large, large ~ spacious, big !~ spacious — the attested chain problem). The web carries NEARNESS, not identity; distance accumulates along every path, so a chain is a walk, not a proof — follow synonym links far enough and you can reach an antonym. The chain() function returns walks with this caveat standing.
bound.the_webs_two_axes: The thesaurus runs on two relations and the record now holds both: the POLARITY layer is the antonym web (the 2, the first cut), this layer is the SYNONYM web (the nearness beside it) — and the meaning tree carries both edge kinds, so every walk through the map can move by opposition or by nearness: the two moves every dictionary reader has always made.
